commands.producerVm: QEMU 6.2.0 TCG; certified vmlinuz; disposable initramfs containing exact candidate producer and pinned virtio_scsi.ko; six 8MiB raw disks exposed by virtio-scsi as Google-vendor SCSI disks with serials equal to the six embedded device names
commands.static: python3 verify-candidate.py; build-successor.py twice into distinct output directories; cmp generated CPIO/EFI/inventory/authority

passCondition: raw serial contains each of six exact VM_LINK_PASS markers once, VM_BY_ID_PRODUCER_PASS once, VM_FAIL zero times, and QEMU_WRAPPER_EXIT=0 once
qemuArgv: -L <pinned-qemu>/usr/share/qemu -accel tcg -nodefaults -no-reboot -nographic -serial stdio -monitor none -m 512 -kernel <certified-vmlinuz> -initrd <disposable-producer-test-initrd> -append console=ttyS0 panic=-1 -device virtio-scsi-pci,id=scsi0 plus six raw 8MiB scsi-hd devices, vendor=Google, serial=v3-<role>
scope: Disposable local VM only; no GCP, key, signing, production boot or provisioning
